_comment: Aider resolves model metadata through litellm's built-in table. Nothing in that
table matches a model arriving as a generic OpenAI endpoint on our gateway, so
without this file aider assumes an 8k context and prices everything at zero.
The 8k assumption is the damaging one: aider silently truncates the repo map and
the chat history to fit, and the model then edits files it can no longer see.
Context windows are copied from the gateway catalogue (deploy: gateway-config
ConfigMap, model_info.max_context_window) and must be kept in agreement with it.
Costs are deliberately zero here: the gateway is the meter. A second, client-side
cost estimate that disagrees with the bill is worse than no estimate at all.
